decisions.reason: Its close fit with existing agricultural crates and the firm's design and engineering capabilities gives high absorptive capacity, making early learning likely and withdrawal unlikely.
Foldable large containers extend the firm's container expertise and benefit from dedicated development, so the firm can assimilate feedback and improve, keeping withdrawal probability low.
Stackable crates are core to the firm's packaging knowledge, and although competition exists, absorptive capacity supports learning and adaptation, so keep.
Medium-duty rackable pallets build directly on existing pallet engineering and manufacturing, allowing the firm to interpret results and refine the product, making withdrawal improbable.
Plastic pallets with load retainers are closely related to current pallet lines and have dedicated promotion, indicating high absorptive capacity and commitment, so keep.
